source: QU Undergraduate Catalog 2026-2027, Chapter 10 (degree requirements) and Chapter 11 (course listing)
note: Source: QU Undergraduate Catalog 2026-2027, Bachelor of Business Administration. 'Business Administration' is not one program — it is 6 separate accredited majors (Accounting, MIS, Economics, Finance, Management, Marketing), each with its own required courses, sharing a common Core Curriculum + College Core/Supporting Requirements. This file covers one concentration. Scope explicitly excludes: the Minor requirement (15 CH — students choose a minor from another BBA major, not modeled here), the 4+1 combined Bachelor's/Master's program (a separate accelerated track), the Arabic-track core curriculum variant (English track modeled here), and Free Elective / generic package courses (pools, not specific codes — not invented). Total required credits per catalog: 125.
